'''Faedral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. Working as security for the [[Overwatch]], in [[3630 BBY]] he and a fellow hunter [[Zaamsk]] engaged the rogue terrorist [[Kaliyo Djannis|Firebrand]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] at the power junction in [[District 1327|Breaktown]]. However, the hunters were defeated and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Faedral appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter X: Anarchy in Paradise'''.
